body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "Last year, we were at roughly about 70% utilization. This year, we expect to be about 90% utilization." Metric: Engineering capacity utilisation. Target: ~90%. Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Three months later (Oct-24) FY25 utilisation was 'near about 85% ... the optimum', with no reference to the 90% said in July. Q4FY25: 'near about 80-85% now'.
